people.name: Jack McDuff
people.extract: Eugene McDuffy, known professionally as "Brother" Jack McDuff or "Captain" Jack McDuff, was an American jazz organist and organ trio bandleader. He was most prominent during the hard bop and soul jazz era of the 1960s, often performing with an organ trio. He is also credited with giving guitarist George Benson his first break.
highlights: American jazz organist and organ trio bandleader.
Prominent during the hard bop and soul jazz era.
Credited with giving George Benson his first break.

people.name: Sitakant Mahapatra
people.extract: Sitakant Mahapatra is an Indian poet and literary critic in Odia as well as English. He served in the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) from 1961 until he retired in 1995, and has since held ex officio posts such as Banking Ombudsman of Odisha and Chairman of National Book Trust, New Delhi etc.
highlights: Indian poet and literary critic in Odia and English.
Served in the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) from 1961-1995.
Held posts like Banking Ombudsman of Odisha.

people.name: Reinhold Messner
people.extract: Reinhold Andreas Messner is an Italian climber, explorer, and author from the German-speaking province of South Tyrol. He made the first solo ascent of Mount Everest and, along with Peter Habeler, the first ascent of Everest without supplementary oxygen. He was the first person to climb all 14 eight-thousanders, doing so without supplementary oxygen. Messner was the first to cross Antarctica and Greenland with neither snowmobiles nor dog sleds and also crossed the Gobi Desert alone. He is widely considered to be the greatest high-altitude mountaineer of all time.
highlights: First solo ascent of Mount Everest.
First ascent of Everest without supplementary oxygen.
First person to climb all 14 eight-thousanders.
